legal.draftNotice: Draft – to be reviewed by legal counsel before public launch.
termsBody: Allingo provides test-prep tools and an AI tutor for personal study. Practice tests are written by Allingo and are not official ETS, Cambridge, JF/JEES or Hanban exams.
You are responsible for keeping your account secure and must not share paid accounts.
Results and estimated scores are for reference only and do not replace official certificates.
AI-generated content may contain mistakes; verify with a teacher when needed.
Paid plans, refunds and AI credits follow the pricing policy published at the time of purchase.
privacyBody: We collect your email/phone, study progress, answers and recordings (when you consent to voice processing) to provide the service.
Essays and recordings are stored in a private bucket, accessed only via short-lived signed URLs, and deleted after 90 days (Free) or 365 days (Pro).
Content sent to AI models never includes your name, email or phone number.
You can request account deletion in Settings; deletion completes within 72 hours, and billing records are retained in anonymized form as required by law.
We comply with Vietnam's Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection.
legal.draftPendingDesc: This text is being reviewed by counsel and may change before Allingo's public launch.
legal.consentNote: This document requires your consent when you use the related feature.
refundBody: Monthly/yearly Pro plans can be cancelled at any time in Account → Billing; you keep Pro until the end of the paid period.
You may request a refund within 7 days of your first payment if you have used less than 20% of the period's AI quota – send the request from the Support page.
Used AI credits are not refundable; promotional/beta credits cannot be exchanged for money.
When a refund is issued, the e-invoice is adjusted as required by law and Pro access ends immediately.
If a system error costs you usage, support will grant compensation credits after verification.
voiceBody: Speaking practice, shadowing and pronunciation scoring (coming soon) need recordings of your voice.
Recordings are stored in a private bucket, accessible only through time-limited signed links, and deleted automatically after 90 days (Free) or 365 days (Pro).
Your voice is sent to our speech recognition/pronunciation provider only to produce your results; it is not used to train models.
You can withdraw consent at any time in Settings; existing recordings are deleted within 72 hours.
Processing follows Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection (biometric data is sensitive data).

surveys.npsDescD14: Two weeks into the beta – your answer helps decide what comes next.
surveys.thanks: Thank you! Your feedback has been recorded.
surveys.onboardingDesc: 5 questions to help us evaluate the beta.

support.title: Help center
support.subtitle: Send a request – support replies first within {hours} hours, by email and in-app notification.
support.guestDesc: Guest accounts cannot send requests yet. Sign up for free (progress is kept) or use the Contact page.
support.newDesc: Describe the problem as specifically as you can (time, test, device).
support.subject: Subject
support.messagePlaceholder: What happened? What have you tried?
support.attachTrace: Attach the latest error trace ({trace}…) so engineers can look it up quickly

errors.subject: Subject must be 3–200 characters.
errors.message: Message must be at least 3 characters.

support.hintFeedback: Quick feedback: the "Feedback" button in the top bar (with a screenshot).
support.hintReport: Wrong answer key or typo: the "Report question" button on the review page.
support.emptyDesc: Requests you send will appear here with their status.
support.reopenNote: This request is resolved – replying reopens it.
support.closedNote: This request is closed and no longer accepts replies.

adminOps.forbiddenDesc: This page is for administrators only.

overview.title: Operations admin
overview.desc: System health, support SLA and entry points to beta admin sections.

beta.title: Closed beta
beta.desc: Waitlist, batched invitations (≤ 50/day) and the weekly KPI report.

feedback.title: In-app feedback
feedback.desc: Feedback with screenshots and trace ids – triage within one working day.

content.title: Content
content.desc: Question reports (48-hour SLA) and item statistics: p-value, discrimination, retire suggestions.

support.title: Support tickets
support.desc: First reply within 24 hours, reply by email + in-app, grant compensation credits.

users.title: Users
users.desc: Search, view profiles (PII masked), lock/unlock, deletion requests, read-only impersonation.

ai.title: AI quality
ai.desc: 👍/👎 per prompt version, cost and guardrail refusals.

system.title: System
system.desc: Queues, dead letters + replay, partitions, outbox and feature flags.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.desc: Look up every admin and system action by actor, action, entity and time.

adminOps.reasonMin: Required, at least {min} characters – written to the audit log.

beta.confirmQueueDesc: Invitations go into batch "{batch}" and are sent automatically at 09:00 (Vietnam time) within the daily limit, or when you press "Send now". Emails that already have an active invitation are skipped.
beta.emailDesc: Paste emails (one per line, up to 500) for partners/staff who are not on the waitlist.
beta.sendHint: Sends queued invitations in queue order.
beta.confirmSendDesc: Invitation emails go out immediately (sent emails cannot be recalled). Remaining today: {remaining}.
beta.confirmRevokeDesc: The code for {email} will stop working. To invite again you must create a new invitation (new code).
beta.sendBatchHint: Sends only queued invitations of batch {batch} (current filter).

content.question: Question
content.handleDesc: The reporter gets an in-app notification when the status is Confirmed, Fixed or Rejected. Fix the question in the CMS (new version via the two-step workflow).
content.notePlaceholder: e.g. fixed the answer key in version 2
content.recomputeDesc: Recomputes p-value and discrimination for every question from the last 365 days of attempts (replica). May take a few tens of seconds.

support.subject: Subject
support.pick: Pick a ticket to see the conversation and reply.
support.closedNoReply: Ticket is closed – no further replies.
support.notePlaceholder: e.g. compensation for Part 3 audio bug
support.confirmCreditDesc: Credits are added to {name} immediately (admin_adjust ledger, audited). Note: "{note}".
support.errNote: The note needs at least 3 characters.

users.privacyNote: Results mask email/phone; the search string is not logged (only the search action).
users.typeToSearch: Type at least 2 characters or pick a filter to search.
users.name: Display name
users.pick: Pick a user to see their profile.
users.privilegedNote: Admin accounts: cannot be impersonated; locking/deleting requires superadmin.

lock.title: Lock {name}'s account?
lock.desc: All sessions are revoked immediately; the user cannot sign in until unlocked.

unlock.title: Unlock {name}'s account?
unlock.desc: The user can sign in again immediately.

deletion.title: Delete {name}'s data?
deletion.desc: Only when the user asked and their identity was verified via a ticket. Data is deleted within 72 hours – it CANNOT be restored.
deletion.ack: I verified the requester's identity and understand this cannot be undone.

impersonate.title: View as {name}?
impersonate.desc: READ-ONLY token for 10 minutes; every request is audited. Use only to investigate tickets – never act on the user's behalf.

imp.readOnlyDesc: Data is loaded with a separate token (not your session). The API blocks all writes and admin pages; email/phone are masked.

ai.targetNote: GATE-2 target: explanation 👍 rate ≥ 80%. 👎 includes "not helpful" and "wrong".

system.confirmReplayDesc: Job {job} ({id}) runs again with the same jobId (idempotent). Check the failure cause before replaying.
system.noHandler: This job has no handler to replay.
system.flagsDesc: Changes take effect on every server within 60 seconds. Turning a kill-switch off makes the API return 503 and the UI hide the feature.
system.confirmFlagDesc: The change applies to every user immediately and is audited.

audit.hint: Actions ending in "." or "*" match by prefix (e.g. user. or beta.*). Defaults to the last 30 days.

queue.decisionDesc: Each question goes through the two-step review state machine (stage by current status, four-eyes rule at review 2). Invalid questions are reported individually and do not block the others.
queue.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. option B is also correct – fix the distractor
queue.shortcuts: Shortcuts: J/K – next/previous · A – approve · R – reject · X – toggle selection
queue.noSelection: Select a question to preview it.

preview.title: Preview
preview.dupNone: No similar question above the threshold.
preview.rendered: Preview as a learner (answers filled in)

checks.content_invalid: Content does not match the question schema ({path})
checks.answer_key_not_in_options: Answer {key} is not among the options
checks.passage_missing: This Part needs a passage/script but none is attached
checks.audio_missing: Listening question has no audio yet (TTS/recording needed before publishing)
checks.word_limit_missing: Completion item has no word limit (NO MORE THAN … WORDS)
checks.accepted_exceeds_word_limit: Accepted answer exceeds the word limit in gap(s) {gaps}
checks.too_few_options: Options cannot be reused but only {options} options for {items} items (add distractors)
checks.select_count_mismatch: Choose-count ({expected}) differs from the number of correct answers ({actual})

errors.invalid_transition: Not allowed in the current status
errors.role_not_allowed: Your role cannot perform this step
errors.four_eyes: Four-eyes rule: the review 1 approver cannot approve review 2
errors.ai_check_failed: AI check failed – fix before submitting
errors.ai_check_only: The AI check step is run by the system

import.title: Import questions from Excel
import.desc: Download the template, fill one question per row, upload to check every row – errors are shown per row/column and duplicates are detected before anything is written. Nothing is written until you confirm.
import.skipDup: Skip rows that look like existing questions (default: import and flag them in the review queue)
import.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MB.
import.dryRunDone: Check complete: {valid} valid row(s), {errors} row(s) with errors
import.committed: Imported {created} draft question(s) into the review queue
import.fingerprintMismatch: The file changed since the check – please check again.

importIssues.unsupported_type: Question type not supported by the Excel template: {value}
importIssues.passage_conflict: Passage text differs from row {first_row} with the same passage_key (the first row is used)
importIssues.duplicate_in_file: Duplicate of row {of_row} in the file (similarity {similarity})

generate.title: AI drafts a whole test from a blueprint
generate.desc: Choose the number of questions per Part, the difficulty mix and topics. AI writes new items (fictional names, never copied from real tests) → AI check → duplicate filter → draft questions in the review queue, attached to a draft test.
generate.multiTexts: Part 7 – texts per set of ≥ 5 questions
generate.noParts: Enter a number of questions for at least one Part.
generate.publishBlocked: Cannot publish yet: {count} question(s) are not fully reviewed

programArea.title: {program} practice is coming soon
programArea.desc: Allingo is finishing tests, scoring and study plans for {program}. Join the waitlist to hear as soon as it opens – meanwhile keep practising the programs that are open.
